verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents natural-language analysis through its remote MCP server and Dives, so users can query without writing SQL and save answers that stay current. For grounding, it offers Guides: markdown documents capturing org metric definitions and join conventions so agents produce accurate SQL. Governance comes from read-only MCP restriction and Share include patterns and grants. However, Guides are advisory markdown rather than an enforced semantic layer, and the NL experience largely depends on an external agent client. missing for 10: an enforced or governed semantic model that guarantees correct joins and metrics, a documented business-user-facing NL Q&A flow beyond agent/MCP setup, and independent or hands-on evidence that answers avoid hallucinated joins.
